account: During my morning market walk, my neighbour told me Townsfolk 02 had said the bakery was being decorated with lights. Neither my neighbour nor I knows the occasion. I have seen the builder carrying a lantern near the bridge, but I do not know whether that is connected. I also saw the baker carrying a sack of bread across the bridge and then stocking the market stall; that looks like ordinary business, not evidence of anything secret. Several townsfolk said they had no news, and the secretary had received no correspondence this morning. My guess is that the lights might be for a celebration or gathering, but I have no confirmation, and no reason yet to think anything improper is happening. I am now beside the baker at the stall and can ask directly. Separately, my neighbour confirmed our usual three-o'clock tea at the east-bank cottage at (16, -60, 105); that invitation appears routine.
